extracted.intended_audience: members of the public who want to use the Virginia Regulatory Town Hall (registered or unregistered users)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and policy for registering as a public user of the Virginia Regulatory Town Hall, setting notification preferences, password recovery, and participation in public comment forums. Covers what information is required/optional, how notifications are delivered, and how email/privacy are handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Why become a registered user
rubrics_metrics.description: You can choose to be notified about regulatory meetings or regulatory actions or both. You can choose to be notified about an entire secretariat, board or an individual chapter of the Virginia Administrative Code. Every night if actions or meetings have been scheduled which match your preferences the Town Hall will send you an email. And it's free! Agencies can also use the Town Hall user list to send you information when they wish to distribute information to those interested in their board.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registration's primary benefit is email notifications tailored to your selected scope (secretariat, board, or chapter). Registration also makes it possible for agencies to send targeted information to users interested in their board.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to register
rubrics_metrics.description: Click here to register. You will be asked for your email address (which you will later use to log in) and your name and a password. You may fill out the optional telephone and address information if you wish agencies to have access to that information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After providing required fields (email, name, password) you will be asked to specify your notification preferences. Telephone and address are optional and only needed if you want agencies to have that access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting notification preferences (initial)
rubrics_metrics.description: Immediately after registering as a public user, you will get a screen to select your notification preferences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the types of notifications (actions, meetings, or both) and the scope (secretariat, board, chapter) on the initial screen shown right after registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Changing notification preferences later
rubrics_metrics.description: You can change these preferences later by choose the "Notification preferences" option from the left menu.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'Notification preferences' menu option to update your selections after the initial registration; a sample screen is provided on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification scope choices
rubrics_metrics.description: You can choose to be notified about an entire secretariat, board or an individual chapter of the Virginia Administrative Code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notifications are sent nightly when actions or meetings have been scheduled that match your selected preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Password recovery
rubrics_metrics.description: If you lose your password, on the login screen there is a link "Can't remember your password?" After you click on this link you can enter your email address and the Town Hall will email your password to you at that address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'Can't remember your password?' link on the login screen and enter the email you registered with; the system will email your password to that address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email usage and privacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Your email address will only be used for two purposes: (1) to send you the notification emails that you sign up to receive and (2) for DPB and Agency regulatory coordinators to email you special announcements relating to the boards and regulations that match your preferences. DPB will not provide your information to others or use it for any other purpose. For more information see our privacy policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email is restricted to notifications and targeted announcements from DPB/agency coordinators; consult the linked privacy policy for further details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comment forums: registration not required
rubrics_metrics.description: You do not have to register to use the public comment forums. When you are not logged in as a registered public user you can enter a comment. You will be able to enter your name and, optionally, your organization along with the comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registration is optional for commenting; unregistered users can submit comments and optionally provide organization. Registered users are useful if an agency wishes to contact you regarding your comment or send you additional information directly.
